## What does this mean?

When choosing an LLM, does it help to consider what each candidate model is good at, not only compare the request with past requests?

## Why does it matter?

Two requests can look similar while requiring different model strengths. A
candidate profile attempts to say, for example, that one model is strong on
careful multi-step explanations while another is strong on short factual tasks.
